IRON YARD -- one-time owner-directed PUBLIC v64 functional stability release, 14 November 2026.

Deploy ONLY to the existing PUBLIC IRON YARD owned by Roblox user
9774173158, universe 10775909016, root place 99189039770065.
Never change visibility, create another experience or use a private place.

Last verified PUBLIC baseline: v63, Roblox place version 59,
source 6a9c4c42bed7a27f26a5fbb819ecb816c640cb18.
This release contains the reviewed, CI-green MatchService scheduler
fault containment fix from PR #105, source commit
41f2e3fcb11b20e5cdf663cd4c3a019042e1c1b0.
No new game mode, no prototype, no mock behavior, no new assets.

The actual game loop now survives a transient Roblox runtime exception.
After three consecutive failures it clears the duel combat state,
unanchors only the original duel-preparation character roots, discards
stale duel state and returns to WAITING. No fake victories or
progression resets. Ordinary phase timings and weapon logic are unchanged.

Require a successful Rojo/Luau main CI for the EXACT one-shot release
authorization commit and independent Open Cloud checks of the original
owner, universe, root place and PUBLIC visibility before uploading.
Publish at most once. Never bypass a failed guard or claim live Android
runtime verification based on a green GitHub CI.
